note: confirmation dataset -> its screening dataset. Since v8 the screen is a DIRECTIONAL FILTER, not a gate: a candidate is confirmed on the confirmation dataset if it was PROMISING on the screen (positive mean paired gain), even if the screen's strict sign-test printed discarded (that test is too sensitive to the screen's 1/3-item sampling). The strict keep + holdout gate is the confirmation dataset (m5_all). tools/promote.py condition 1b enforces the promising-on-screen check.

legacy.m5_ca1: v0-v3 screening tier (one store, item-level metric); kept for its run history
legacy.m5_3: v4-v7 screen (one store per state); RETIRED v8 - its degenerate hierarchy (state==store, total=3 series) flipped aggregation-interacting verdicts vs m5_all
